svg.title: Fault storm
svg.text: Fault storm: 96 nodes fail together under one spine group
racks 2–4: 96 nodes fail network checks in 10 min
reboot all 96: jobs killed, switch still
spine group holds 96 of 96 failures → storm;
r6's node is outside the storm domain: remediated at the normal rate
human or domain health recovers → re-check nodes, remediate individually
